findings.claim: The the-box-model o3 mastery item (margin-bottom 24px vs margin-top 16px, answer 24px) reuses the exact numbers and structure of the published topic item 'o3 sibling margins' in the-box-model/artifact.gift; only the nouns changed. A learner who did the formative quiz answers from recognition, so the mastery self-check signal is false.
findings.recommendation: Replace with a different collapse demand with fresh numbers.

findings.claim: The forms-and-html5-validation o3 mastery item asks the same question as the topic item 'o3 why the server checks' (why must the server validate again), reworded. Same question in different words is a duplicate under the module's own design rule.
findings.recommendation: Shift the reasoning demand, e.g. a bug report where invalid data reached the database and ask which layer failed.

findings.claim: The flexbox o3 mastery item is the topic item 'o3 sharing leftover space' with different numbers: same structure, ratio and distractor logic, so it adds little beyond re-running a memorized formula.
findings.recommendation: Vary the mechanism: include a gap that reduces leftover space.

findings.claim: The task 7 failure messages name the complete answers outright ('...is a section', 'the next level is h2') and print on the mandated baseline run before the learner reads the tasks, collapsing the lab's no-answer-disclosure framing.
findings.recommendation: Reword the task 7 messages to the outcome level, keeping element and level names for the hints.

findings.claim: The lab claims semantic-html-page-structure#o1 and accessibility-basics#o3, but the public tests evidence only one element choice (section) and only the submit control's focusability.
findings.recommendation: Narrow the claimed objectives to the tested slices, or extend the task 7/10 assertions so the claims are earned.

findings.claim: Task 10 claims the submit control takes keyboard focus, but programmatic focus() also succeeds on tabindex=-1 elements Tab never reaches.
findings.recommendation: Additionally assert tabIndex >= 0 (or drive a real Tab keypress).
